exposure: mode of delivery (Caesarean section, vaginal delivery)
outcome: size of anterior abdominal wall defect
cohort: This study included 135 newborns with gastroschisis born between 1987 and 2020.
finding: Caesarean delivery was associated with a smaller size of the anterior abdominal wall defect and a lower frequency of retroperitoneal organ eventration in newborns with gastroschisis.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery was associated with a smaller size of the anterior abdominal wall defect and a lower frequency of retroperitoneal organ eventration in newborns with gastroschisis.
